articles.summary: Grant LaFontaine explains how selling Pokémon cards inspired a billion-dollar business
articles.body:
World Service , · 25 Nov 2026 , · 17 mins

Grant LaFontaine is the co-founder and CEO of Whatnot, the live shopping platform where independent sellers generated more than $8 billion in sales last year. He explains how selling Pokémon cards as a child led to him co-founding the largest independent livestream shopping platform in North America, the UK and Europe, and why he backed livestream shopping long before most investors saw its potential. articles.title: Djibouti: The Man Who Dared
articles.summary: War hero turned nationalist, Mahmoud Harbi defied colonial rule to fight for independence in today’s Djibouti.
articles.body:
World War Two hero, firebrand nationalist – and the man who dared to defy France in the Horn of Africa.

Born in 1921, Mahmoud Harbi fought with the Free French Navy in the Second World War, winning the Croix de Guerre, before returning home to French Somaliland determined to end colonial rule.

He founded the Democratic Union Party in 1947, giving voice to demands for independence and Pan-Somalism.

By 1956, Harbi was vice president of the local Government Council – inside the system, but increasingly against it.

He broke with France, backing full independence as Paris pushed a 1958 referendum that nationalists condemned as rigged and poisoned by ethnic division.

Forced into exile, Harbi died in a mysterious 1960 plane crash off the Italian island of Elba, amid unproven rumours of sabotage.

Djibouti would not gain independence until 1977.

This film tells the story of the visionary who tried to get there first.

articles.title: Veruschka: morre a primeira supermodelo alemã | G1
articles.standfirst: Conhecida por sua participação em 'Blow-Up' e trabalhos de body painting, Veruschka transformou a moda em expressão artística. Membro de uma família que fez parte da resistência antinazista, ela tinha 87 anos.
articles.summary: Veruschka, a primeira supermodelo da Alemanha e estrela de Blow-Up, morreu aos 87 anos em Berlim, deixando um legado marcado pela arte e resistência antinazista.
articles.body:
Veruschka von Lehndorff em 'Depois Daquele Beijo' — Foto: Reprodução

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Veruschka von Lehndorff, considerada a primeira supermodelo da Alemanha, morreu na terça-feira (24), aos 87 anos. Ela estava em sua casa, em Berlim, segundo relataram familiares ao jornal alemão "Bild".

Com 1,83 metros de altura, ar misterioso e extravagante, a modelo, nascida com o nome de Vera Anna Gottliebe Gräfin von Lehndorff, se tornou um símbolo da moda nos anos 1960 e 1970.

Ela alcançou projeção internacional com sua participação no filme "Blow-Up - Depois Daquele Beijo" (1966), do italiano Michelangelo Antonioni. Estampou capas de inúmeras revistas e circulou entre artistas como Salvador Dalí e Helmut Newton.

Apesar da fama nas passarelas e diante das câmeras, ela nunca se definiu apenas como modelo, mas sempre como artista. Suas obras de pintura corporal, desenvolvidas em parceria com o artista e fotógrafo Holger Trülzsch, foram alguns de seus trabalhos artísticos que ficaram conhecidos internacionalmente.

A empresa Gräfin von Lehndorff Design e.K., de sua irmã, Catharina Kappelhoff-Wulff, publicou um comunicado em que diz: "Lamentamos a perda de uma mulher extraordinária, da irmã de Catharina e de uma artista que moldou nossa casa desde o início.”

Veruschka também chamou atenção por seu trabalho com pintura corporal. Em parceria com o artista e fotógrafo Holger Trülzsch, produziu séries fotográficas de body painting.

Neste ano, o Museu da Prússia Oriental, em Lüneburg, dedicou aos dois uma exposição especial. Suas obras já foram exibidas em alguns dos museus mais renomados dos Estados Unidos e da Europa, incluindo instituições em Nova York, Paris e Milão.

Origem em família aristocrática antinazista

Veruschka em 'Casino Royale' — Foto: Reprodução

Vera von Lehndorff nasceu em 14 de maio de 1939, em Königsberg, na antiga região alemã da Prússia Oriental, hoje Kalinigrado e parte da Rússia. Ela passou seus primeiros anos de vida na propriedade da família, o Castelo de Steinort, que pertencia aos Lehndorff desde o século 15.

Seu pai, o conde Heinrich von Lehndorff-Steinort, fez parte da resistência antinazista e esteve envolvido na conspiração de 20 de julho de 1944, a mais famosa tentativa de assassinar o ditador Adolf Hitler e derrubar o regime nazista durante a Segunda Guerra Mundial.

Após a tentativa fracassada de assassinato, ele foi preso e executado em 4 de setembro de 1944.

Vera tinha cinco anos na época. Os nazistas prenderam a família sob a política do regime de punição coletiva. Sua mãe, que estava grávida, foi enviada para um campo de trabalhos forçados, e Vera e suas irmãs foram colocadas em um orfanato da SS.

Após a guerra, a família perdeu sua propriedade ancestral na Prússia Oriental, que ficou em território anexado pela Polônia. A família passou a viver em campos de refugiados. Veruschka viveu em várias casas e mudou frequentemente de escola.

Inicialmente, ela queria ser artista, estudou arte e foi para a Itália. Em Florença, o fotógrafo Ugo Mulas (1928–1973) notou a jovem alemã excepcionalmente alta. Ela começou então a trabalhar como modelo, adotando o pseudônimo Veruschka (diminutivo de Vera).

Sua grande ascensão aconteceu na década de 1960. Veruschka trabalhou em Paris e Nova York, apareceu em capas internacionais da Vogue e, em 1967, na capa da revista americana Life. Por um tempo, ela esteve entre as modelos mais bem pagas do mundo.

Em 1966, Veruschka estrelou o filme "Blow-Up - Depois Daquele Beijo", de Michelangelo Antonioni (1912–2007). Apenas alguns minutos em cena foram suficientes para imortalizá-la. Isso surpreendeu a própria Veruschka: "Nunca entendi por que tive tanto sucesso; com apenas duas cenas e uma fala, me tornei mundialmente famosa!"

Em meados da década de 1970, após conflitos com a então editora-chefe da Vogue americana, Veruschka se afastou em grande parte da indústria tradicional da moda.

Nos últimos anos, Veruschka von Lehndorff viveu uma vida reclusa em Berlim. Até o fim, valorizou e interagiu ativamente com jovens artistas, e essa troca foi parte integrante de seu cotidiano. Ela faleceu em casa, cercada por amigos e familiares. Parte de seu patrimônio foi doada ao Museu Estadual da Prússia Oriental, em Lüneburg, no norte da Alemanha, que documenta e celebra a história, a arte e a cultura da antiga província alemã, que após a Segunda Guerra Mundial foi anexada pela Polônia e a Rússia.

articles.title: Ufopa ativa protocolo de emergência por má qualidade do ar no Pará | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida prevê atividades remotas e restrições no funcionamento de serviços da universidade em sete municípios. Decisão foi tomada após indicadores apontarem níveis críticos de poluição atmosférica.
articles.summary: A Ufopa ativou um protocolo de emergência e suspendeu aulas presenciais em sete municípios do Pará após a qualidade do ar atingir níveis críticos de poluição.
articles.body:
Região ficou encoberta por fumaça em Santarém — Foto: Rede Social

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

A Universidade Federal do Oeste do Pará (Ufopa) ativou o Protocolo Institucional de Emergência em sete dos oito municípios onde mantém campi. A medida foi adotada após indicadores científicos apontarem que a qualidade do ar na região atingiu a classificação péssima nesta semana, devido à concentração de fumaça na atmosfera.

A decisão foi oficializada por meio de uma portaria publicada nesta quarta-feira (25) e estabelece mudanças no funcionamento das atividades acadêmicas e administrativas da instituição. Entre as medidas estão a realização de atividades remotas e restrições em serviços oferecidos à comunidade universitária.

Segundo a reitora da Ufopa, Aldenize Xavier, a ativação do protocolo considera informações do Comitê de Acompanhamento da Qualidade do Ar e dados científicos levantados pela Sala de Situação da universidade.

A reitora explicou que a decisão segue recomendações de protocolos internacionais de saúde, que orientam a redução de deslocamentos e a suspensão de atividades presenciais quando a qualidade do ar chega a níveis considerados críticos.

“Há protocolos internacionais que recomendam a restrição de deslocamento durante esse período, inclusive para os professores em sala de aula, porque a fumaça acaba interferindo até na respiração”, destacou.

Com a medida, a universidade estabelece regras para o funcionamento do ensino, estágios, pesquisas e atividades de extensão. Também foram previstas orientações para serviços como bibliotecas, transporte intercampi, restaurantes universitários e o Programa de Alimentação Multicampi.

De acordo com Aldenize, o protocolo poderá ser ativado ou desativado conforme a situação da qualidade do ar em cada município. A avaliação será feita com base nos indicadores acompanhados pelo comitê responsável.

A reitora ressaltou que as medidas têm como objetivo reduzir a exposição de estudantes, professores, técnicos e demais trabalhadores à fumaça.

Além das ações emergenciais, a Ufopa mantém articulação com órgãos municipais e federais para estabelecer medidas que auxiliem na tomada de decisões diante dos episódios de poluição atmosférica.

A universidade também começou a discutir estratégias de prevenção para 2027. Segundo Aldenize Xavier, os efeitos do fenômeno El Niño ainda devem ser sentidos nos próximos meses, o que exige planejamento para enfrentar possíveis novos períodos de queimadas e piora na qualidade do ar.

“Estamos trabalhando também na prevenção para o que devemos esperar para o ano de 2027, ainda como consequência dos efeitos do El Niño, que certamente sentiremos por muitos meses”, afirmou.

A universidade orienta que a comunidade acadêmica acompanhe as atualizações sobre o protocolo e as regras específicas para cada campus.

articles.title: Facções venezuelanas crescem e pressionam domínio do PCC em Roraima | G1
articles.standfirst: Relatório aponta que grupos venezuelanos são única facção estrangeira a disputar território no Brasil e mantêm relações com PCC e Comando Vermelho no estado.
articles.summary: Relatório aponta que grupos venezuelanos são única facção estrangeira a disputar território no Brasil e mantêm relações com PCC e Comando Vermelho no estado.
articles.body:
Dólares apreendidos com alvo de operação contra facção Tren de Aragua em Boa Vista — Foto: Arquivo pessoal

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Facções venezuelanas como o Tren de Aragua , o Tren de Guayana e as chamadas 'pandillas' ganharam espaço em Roraima e pressionam o domínio do Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) no estado. É o que aponta o relatório Cenários do Crime Organizado no Brasil , da Agência Brasileira de Inteligência (Abin) e do Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública (FBSP), divulgado nesta terça-feira (24).

Entenda🔎: o relatório trata “facções venezuelanas” como um conjunto, mas não é uma organização única . Para medir o peso desses grupos e compará-los ao PCC e ao Comando Vermelho (CV), o estudo soma em uma só categoria o Tren de Aragua, o Tren de Guayana e as pandillas, que são quadrilhas urbanas autônomas.

O estudo mapeou 31 organizações criminosas relevantes no país. Desse total, 28 nasceram no sistema prisional, duas são milícias do Rio e apenas uma tem origem estrangeira: os grupos venezuelanos que atuam em Roraima. A avaliação levou em conta critérios como controle de território , capacidade financeira , estrutura de operação e domínio de áreas estratégicas .

Segundo o relatório, as facções venezuelanas têm relevância alta em Roraima e são consideradas de média relevância no país. Na prática, isso significa que, dentro de Roraima, esses grupos têm força para impor "regras do crime" nas ruas e nos presídios.

No cenário nacional, a classificação mostra que eles deixaram de ser vistos como quadrilhas comuns. Agora são tratados pela inteligência do país como uma ameaça real à segurança pública .

Segundo o relatório, venezuelanos chegam a formar pequenos grupos em outros estados, mas só e m Roraima conseguiram se firmar na disputa por território. Diferente de máfias internacionais, que atuam em negócios e no transporte de mercadorias e dinheiro, esses grupos disputam espaço armado nas ruas e nos presídios para controlar pontos de venda de drogas .

Integrantes desses grupos atuam no tráfico de drogas na capital Boa Vista , que concentra 70% da população e o principal mercado consumidor do estado. Eles também têm forte presença no sistema prisional, sobretudo na Penitenciária Agrícola Monte Cristo (Pamc), o maior presídio do estado e onde está a maioria dos detentos ligados a facções.

Além do tráfico, o relatório destaca outros crimes na fronteira. O estudo analisa grupos criminosos, e não migrantes ou refugiados, mas aponta que quadrilhas usam o fluxo entre Pacaraima e Santa Elena de Uairén e estradas clandestinas para entrar no Brasil com produtos ilegais. O destaque são armas, que seguem pela BR-174 até Manaus (AM).

O relatório classifica Roraima como um estado com três forças criminosas relevantes: o PCC e o Comando Vermelho (CV), as duas maiores facções do Brasil, e os grupos venezuelanos. Esse cenário existe em nove estados, mas no estado tem duas particularidades .

A primeira é que os grupos venezuelanos, junto com o Terceiro Comando Puro (TCP), que saiu do Rio para Minas Gerais, são os únicos terceiros grupos criminosos relevante que não nasceram no próprio estado .

A segunda é exclusiva de Roraima: os venezuelanos são neutros . Isso quer dizer que mantêm relações ao mesmo tempo com o PCC e com o CV, sem aliança formal e sem conflito direto com nenhum dos dois. Nos outros estados, as três facções vivem guerra geral ou aliança de duas contra uma.

Apesar do avanço das facções venezuelanas, o relatório mostra que o PCC continua sendo a organização mais forte em Roraima . A relevância do grupo é considerada muito alta no estado e alta no país. Segundo o documento, a facção domina a venda de drogas nas ruas em quase todos os municípios e também atua na região de fronteira e no garimpo ilegal.

Entenda🔎: As classificações medem o nível de ameaça de cada facção em quatro graus: Muito alta indica domínio no local e forte risco às instituições. Alta aponta grupos que lideram o crime, mesmo quando dividem espaço com rivais. Média define facções que representam uma ameaça mais consistente que a de grupos pontuais, enquadrados como baixa.

Isso faz de Roraima uma exceção na Amazônia. O CV controla a maior parte da Região Norte, mas Roraima funciona como uma “ilha” do PCC . Ou seja, é o único estado do Norte onde a facção paulista tem mais integrantes e maior capacidade de operação que o grupo carioca, segundo o levantamento.

O PCC lidera o estado há mais de uma década. Entre 2002 e 2010, a principal facção local era o Primeiro Comando da Maioria (PCM), criado na Pamc. Em 2011, líderes do PCM foram transferidos para presídios federais e se filiaram ao PCC. Com a transferência de líderes da Família do Norte (FDN) em 2013, o grupo paulista consolidou o domínio.

Outra particularidade de Roraima apontada pelo relatório é a ligação do crime organizado com o garimpo ilegal . Integrantes do PCC atuam em garimpos ilegais de ouro e cassiterita no Alto Rio Uraricoera, dentro da Terra Indígena Yanomami.

Aviões de pequeno porte usam pistas clandestinas em fazendas no entorno da terra indígena, com destaque para Mucajaí. Esses aviões levam drogas nas viagens de ida e volta dos garimpos.

O domínio do PCC, porém, enfrenta riscos, segundo o relatório. Além da expansão venezuelana em Boa Vista, o estudo aponta que o PCC perdeu espaço no Amazonas e reduziu o apoio aos grupos locais do Norte e do Nordeste. Isso aconteceu porque a cúpula da facção em São Paulo passou a priorizar a exportação de drogas para a Europa e a África.

O estudo diz ainda que a crise econômica e política na Venezuela, somada às restrições para migração aos Estados Unidos, pode aumentar a chegada de venezuelanos a Roraima. Isso pode estimular ainda mais a influência das facções venezuelanas e aumentar a pressão sobre a permanência do PCC no topo.

Já o Comando Vermelho aparece no relatório com relevância média no estado e no país. Segundo o estudo, a atuação do grupo se destaca na região de fronteira e no Sul de Roraima, na divisa com o Amazonas, estado onde a facção carioca domina.

articles.title: PE tem ao menos 13 facções com quadrilhas ligadas ao PCC e CV | G1
articles.standfirst: Relatório inédito da Abin detalha atuação de organizações criminosas do estado. Chamadas de 'bondes' ou 'comandos', parte delas usa infraestrutura viária para exportar drogas.
articles.summary: Estudo da Abin detalha como facções criminosas em Pernambuco, como o PCC e o Comando Litoral Sul, usam portos e aeroportos para exportar drogas e dominar territórios.
articles.body:
Operação insanidade busca identificar e desarticular organização criminosa em Petrolina no Sertão de Pernambuco. — Foto: Divulgação/ PCPE

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Ao menos 13 facções criminosas atuam em Pernambuco e três dominam o mercado ilegal, incluindo o Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC), de abrangência nacional, e duas de origem local. Os dados constam do relatório "Cenários do Crime Organizado no Brasil" , produzido pela Agência Brasileira de Inteligência ( Abin ) em parceria com o Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública (FBSP).

De acordo com o levantamento, divulgado na terça-feira (24), o estado tem uma posição geográfica considerada estratégica para a atuação das organizações criminosas com acesso a terminais como o Porto do Recife , o Complexo Portuário de Suape, em Ipojuca , e o Aeroporto dos Guararapes. Essa infraestrutura é utilizada na logística de exportação de drogas, principalmente cocaína.

Conforme o relatório, as três principais facções são:

o Primeiro Comando da Capital (PCC) de Pernambuco , que tem relevância alta no estado e moderada no Brasil;

o Comando Litoral Sul (CLS) , com relevâncias altas no estado e no Brasil;

e o Bonde da União , de relevância média no estado e baixa no Brasil

Para o pesquisador Armando Nascimento, especialista em Governança, Estratégias e Sistemas de Segurança Pública, o relatório pode funcionar como um guia para a gestão pública no combate ao crime organizado.

"A pesquisa é para que o gestor saiba, quando for tomar a decisão, qual é o grau de relevância que ele tem que estabelecer para responder aquilo, porque ele não vai conseguir responder de uma vez só", explica.

De acordo com o especialista, o Bonde da União tem relação com o PCC, enquanto o CLS tem associação com o Comando Vermelho (CV). O PCC e o CV são as principais facções de atuação nacional, com presença em todos os estados brasileiros .

"O Comando do Litoral Sul é uma organização criminosa de Pernambuco, mas que tem uma relação com o Comando Vermelho. Inclusive, ele adota a simbologia do Comando Vermelho, ou seja, construiu uma rede própria de abastecimento, mas interligado, expandindo-se com o Comando Vermelho", conta.

O estudo mostra que uma das frentes de atuação das facções é o contrabando de cigarros e cargas roubadas e aponta que os grupos menores se aproximam de organizações de abrangência nacional em busca de melhores condições para adquirir drogas e armas. As quadrilhas têm diferenças entre si, mas não deixam de disputar territórios.

"O Comando Litoral Sul tem hoje uma posição mais voltada para a questão do Porto de Suape e das redes internacionais. [...] Quando você pega o PCC, ele está muito linkado à parte de logística, ou seja, a logística atacadista no interior do estado e também o apoio estratégico aos aliados .[...] Como tem os dois [grupos] de nível transnacional atuando em Pernambuco, sim, existe disputa", falou o pesquisador.

O relatório da Abin também fez um levantamento de operações policiais realizadas nos últimos anos no estado, que apontou Pernambuco como integrante das duas principais rotas de narcotráfico do Brasil: a Caipira, que tem origem no Paraguai e na Bolívia, e a Solimões, que sai da Colômbia e do Peru.

Segundo o estudo da Abin, os grupos criminosos atuam nas seguintes frentes:

PCC : logística do narcotráfico de grande escala, mas com menor influência territorial nas zonas mais relevantes

CLS : maior influência no narcotráfico de áreas importantes, como Porto de Galinhas, no Grande Recife

Bonde da União : grupo ainda novo e pouco coeso, que reúne membros de diversos grupos criminosos locais e atua no narcotráfico de diversas regiões do estado

Uma característica do crime organizado de Pernambuco, de acordo com o relatório, é que boa parte das facções locais não tem fidelidade a organizações criminosas de fora do estado. Assim ocorre a formação de pequenos grupos, conhecidos como “bondes”, “grupos” ou “trens”.

Porém, o levantamento indica que, nos últimos anos, houve a aproximação dos grupos locais com os chefes do PCC e do CV, que são maiores e mais estruturadas, a exemplo do Comando Litoral Sul (CLS), identificado como Trem Bala de Ipojuca antes de se associar ao CV.

O estudo aponta também que, antes de se tornar CLS, a atuação da Trem Bala era mais restrita à região de Ipojuca, mas, a partir de 2020, a facção se aproximou do CV e criou uma rede própria de abastecimento de drogas e armas.

Além das três principais facções identificadas pelo levantamento da Abin, Pernambuco tem, ao menos, outros 13 grupos, como Bonde dos Cachorros, Bonde dos Loucos, Comando do Litoral Norte, Bonde do Matuto, Bonde do Mete Bala e Primeiro Comando de Ipojuca. Em 2024, alguns desses grupos menores se uniram e formaram o Bonde da União como contraponto ao crescimento do CLS.

A presença de facções criminosas no Brasil. — Foto: g1 / Abin/Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública

O g1 procurou a Secretaria de Defesa Social para confirmar se o governo avaliou o relatório e quais serão as medidas de segurança tomadas para combater o crime organizado, mas não recebeu resposta até a última atualização desta reportagem.

Para o pesquisador Armando Nascimento, a redução das organizações criminosas pode vir de uma ação integrada entre governos federal, estadual e municipal.

"O governo [federal] necessita implementar para ontem o Sistema Único de Segurança e, principalmente, fortalecer os municípios. Eu não estou dizendo que é o município que vai combater, mas eu preciso começar lá da base, eu preciso de políticas públicas, eu preciso ocupar espaço. E esse espaço que eu preciso ocupar, ele se encontra no município. [...] No que você ocupa espaço, aí você quebra a cadeia de ocupação dessas organizações", explicou.

Em 3 de novembro, o Senado aprovou a proposta de emenda à Constituição (PEC) da Segurança Pública , que dá mais poder ao governo federal para agir contra as organizações criminosas, amplia a cooperação entre União, estados e municípios e prevê punições mais severas para os chefes de facções criminosas, que deverão cumprir pena obrigatoriamente em prisão de segurança máxima.

articles.title: Atibaia ganha destaque no cenário gastronômico internacional | G1
articles.standfirst: Turismo gastronômico? Saiba que pizzaria do interior paulista integra a seleção Excellent Pizzerias 2026
articles.summary: Turismo gastronômico? Saiba que pizzaria do interior paulista integra a seleção Excellent Pizzerias 2026
articles.body:
Conhecida por suas paisagens, pelo clima de montanha e pela tradicional produção de morangos, Atibaia, no interior de São Paulo, também vem conquistando espaço no cenário gastronômico internacional.

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Em 2026, a cidade ganhou destaque no 50 Top Pizza Latin America, guia internacional especializado em pizza, com a inclusão de um estabelecimento local na categoria Excellent Pizzerias, que reconhece pizzarias de excelência em diferentes países da América Latina.

A conquista coloca Atibaia em evidência ao lado de importantes destinos gastronômicos e demonstra que a excelência na culinária italiana não está restrita às grandes capitais.

Da tradição italiana ao reconhecimento internacional

Por trás desse reconhecimento está a Inês Pizza & Pasta, fundada em 2018, no coração de Atibaia. Com uma proposta voltada à pizza napolitana contemporânea, a casa construiu sua identidade a partir da valorização das técnicas tradicionais italianas, da seleção de ingredientes e de uma interpretação própria da gastronomia.

Ao longo dos anos, o empreendimento consolidou sua presença na cidade e, em 2026, alcançou um importante marco em sua trajetória ao integrar a seleção Excellent Pizzerias do 50 Top Pizza Latin America.

O reconhecimento representa não apenas uma conquista para o estabelecimento, mas também uma oportunidade de ampliar a visibilidade da gastronomia local e demonstrar o potencial dos empreendimentos do interior paulista no cenário internacional.

Atibaia em destaque no cenário gastronômico — Foto: Divulgação

Localizada a aproximadamente 65 quilômetros da capital paulista, Atibaia é tradicionalmente procurada por seus atrativos naturais, pelo turismo rural e pela gastronomia.

A presença de um estabelecimento da cidade em um guia gastronômico internacional reforça esse último atrativo e contribui para posicionar o município como um destino de interesse também para os apreciadores da culinária italiana.

O reconhecimento evidencia o potencial da gastronomia regional e mostra como empreendimentos locais podem conquistar projeção internacional, levando o nome de cidades do interior brasileiro a novos públicos.

A pizzaria reconhecida pelo guia internacional é a Inês Pizza & Pasta, localizada na Rua José Alvim, 306, no Centro de Atibaia, interior de São Paulo.

A casa é especializada em pizza napolitana contemporânea e gastronomia italiana, com um cardápio que também contempla massas artesanais e outras especialidades da culinária italiana.

Vale lembrar que o Visite Atibaia e Região Convention & Visitors Bureau (ARC&VB) é uma entidade sem fins lucrativos que atua há mais de 20 anos no fortalecimento do turismo em Atibaia e região.

articles.title: IBGE prorroga seleção no RN com 445 vagas e ganhos de até R$ 5,5 mil | G1

articles.summary: O concurso IBGE RN oferece 445 vagas temporárias para o Censo Agropecuário 2027 com inscrições até novembro de 2026 e provas em 36 municípios do estado.
articles.body:
Inscrições para processo seletivo do IBGE se encerrariam nesta quarta, mas foram prorrogadas — Foto: IBGE/Divulgação

Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

O Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE) prorrogou até 30 de novembro de 2026 as inscrições para o processo seletivo que oferece 445 vagas temporárias para recenseadores no Rio Grande do Norte. As oportunidades estão distribuídas em áreas que abrangem todos os municípios do estado.

Os aprovados vão atuar na coleta de informações para o 12º Censo Agropecuário, Florestal e Aquícola, previsto para 2027. A remuneração poderá chegar a R$ 5.562 , considerando o salário fixo, o bônus por produção e o auxílio-alimentação.

Os interessados devem se inscrever no site da Fundação Cesgranrio , banca organizadora do processo seletivo. A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 70, e o prazo para pagamento foi estendido até 9 de dezembro para os candidatos que não solicitaram isenção.

Para concorrer à função de recenseador, é necessário ter ensino fundamental completo . A remuneração é composta por uma parcela fixa de R$ 1.741 e uma parcela variável por produção, que pode chegar a R$ 2.629.

O cálculo considera a quantidade de entrevistas realizadas e de unidades visitadas, além do cumprimento dos critérios de qualidade estabelecidos pelo IBGE.

Os contratados também terão direito a auxílio-alimentação de até R$ 1.192, proporcional aos dias trabalhados, além de auxílio pré-escolar, férias e 13º salário proporcionais, adicional de um terço de férias e auxílio para custear os deslocamentos necessários ao trabalho.

Entre as atribuições dos recenseadores estão visitar propriedades rurais, coletar e registrar informações em sistema eletrônico, atualizar cadastros e localizações e garantir a qualidade e a confidencialidade dos dados.

Os contratos terão duração inicial prevista de até seis meses, com possibilidade de prorrogação conforme a necessidade das operações e a avaliação de desempenho. O prazo máximo poderá chegar a quatro anos.

As provas objetivas estão previstas para 31 de janeiro de 2027. No Rio Grande do Norte, os candidatos poderão fazer a prova em 36 municípios, inclusive em cidade diferente daquela correspondente à área de trabalho escolhida.

O edital completo, com informações sobre vagas, requisitos e etapas do processo seletivo, está disponível no site da Fundação Cesgranrio .

articles.title: Furto de gado em Orlândia gera prejuízo de R$ 50 mil a produtor | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo agropecuarista, animais chegam a ser mortos na própria propriedade. Ao menos cinco boletins de ocorrência foram registrados desde 2024. Produtores rurais cobram mais segurança.
articles.summary: O furto de gado em Orlândia já soma oito animais levados da propriedade de Paulo Eduardo, que relata o abate cruel das vacas e a falta de segurança na região.
articles.body:
Adicione o g1 como Fonte Preferida no Google

Um agropecuarista de Orlândia (SP) relata ter sofrido um prejuízo de até R$ 50 mil com o furto de oito vacas leiteiras desde 2024. O caso mais recente aconteceu na madrugada de terça-feira (24), quando mais um animal foi furtado da propriedade.

Paulo Eduardo Barbosa, de 47 anos, conta que, em alguns casos, os animais são mortos no próprio sítio e os criminosos deixam para trás apenas a cabeça e as vísceras. A família depende da produção de leite para garantir a renda.

O g1 teve acesso a cinco boletins de ocorrência registrados pelo agropecuarista desde setembro de 2024. Segundo Paulo, nenhum dos casos foi solucionado. Outros produtores rurais ouvidos pela EPTV , afiliada da TV Globo, também relatam furtos de animais, máquinas e equipamentos agrícolas na região.

Em nota, a Secretaria da Segurança Pública de São Paulo (SSP-SP) informou que os casos citados na reportagem estão em investigação.

Pecuarista relata prejuízo de R$ 50 mil após ter oito vacas furtadas em Orlândia, SP — Foto: Reprodução/EPTV

Paulo vende o leite das vacas para a indústria, onde é utilizado na fabricação de queijos. Além de perder o dinheiro investido na compra dos animais, o produtor afirma que os furtos comprometem a renda da família.

“A falta de uma vaca para nós, para muitas pessoas pode parecer pouco, mas para nós que vivem do leite é muito”, disse.

Segundo o agropecuarista, uma vaca leiteira custa entre R$ 6 mil e R$ 10 mil. Com os furtos, ele perde animais cujo investimento ainda não foi recuperado com a venda do leite.

Paulo conta que os crimes ocorrem principalmente à noite e que só percebe a falta dos animais no dia seguinte.

Os cinco boletins de ocorrência obtidos pela reportagem apontam furtos nas seguintes datas:

Todos foram registrados como furtos de autoria desconhecida.

A insegurança também tem afetado os planos de outros produtores rurais de Orlândia. Aos 79 anos, o sitiante João Malvestre desistiu de colocar gado em uma área de pastagem da propriedade por medo de novos crimes.

Segundo ele, criminosos já invadiram o sítio, amarraram um funcionário e levaram mais de 55 itens, entre eles um trator, uma carreta e ventiladores de uma granja.

João também relata que criminosos cortaram cercas da propriedade, mas os animais não saíram do pasto.

O sitiante conta que a propriedade pertenceu ao pai dele e que o medo da violência tem feito com que deixe de frequentar o local como gostaria.

“Eu tenho que deixar de fazer aquilo por medo. Isso é muito ruim, não é justo”, afirmou.

Outro produtor rural ouvido pela EPTV , José, contou que teve um trator levado por criminosos e que, desde então, depende da ajuda de outras pessoas para trabalhar.

Os produtores cobram reforço no policiamento rural e suspeitam que os crimes estejam relacionados. A polícia não informou se há ligação entre as ocorrências.

articles.title: Meet Rishikesh Kumar: US-returned MBA groom marrying Mokama MLA Anant Singh's daughter Shivangi in Bihar's most talked-about wedding, complete with 5 helipads, a horse race and a feast for 4 lakh guests

articles.body: PATNA: Five helipads for VIP guests, a horse race with an SUV as the top prize, luxury cars and a wedding feast planned for around four lakh people. Mokama MLA Anant Singh is leaving no stone unturned for his daughter Shivangi’s wedding, with preparations at his ancestral village turning the celebrations into one of Bihar’s most talked-about events.Spread across large grounds, the arrangements include a Jaipur-inspired wedding pavilion, special lighting, elaborate floral decorations and a separate venue for the horse-racing competition.The scale of the preparations, along with the expensive gifts and the expected guest list, has drawn considerable attention even before the wedding ceremonies begin.But amid all the grandeur, there is another person at the centre of the celebrations: Rishikesh Kumar, also known as Ankit, who is set to marry Shivangi on November 25. While the wedding has put the spotlight on the Singh family, many are curious about the groom and his background.Who is Rishikesh Kumar?Rishikesh is the son of Ranvijay Kumar, a commandant in the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), who belongs to Krishnanagar in Bihta, Patna. The groom holds an MBA degree and has lived in the United States for around 11 years.Rishikesh’s educational background and years in the US have emerged as key details about the groom as the wedding draws attention. He is set to marry Singh’s younger daughter Shivangi on November 25.A luxury Defender and a BMW for the familyThe celebrations have already featured expensive gifts.A Land Rover Defender, estimated to cost between Rs 2.5 crore and Rs 3 crore, has been arranged for the bridegroom. A BMW worth around Rs 1 crore has also been arranged for Singh’s younger son, Abhinav, whose janeu ceremony will take place alongside the wedding.The Defender was chosen by Shivangi and gifted to her on her birthday, according to her brother-in-law Puneet Kumar, who married Singh’s eldest daughter Raj Nandini in 2015.Five helipads, Jaipur-inspired mandap and horse raceThe wedding venue at Singh’s ancestral village of Nadawan in Patna district is being developed across more than 10 bighas. A separate ground spread over nearly 12 bighas has been prepared for a horse-racing competition.The main attraction will be a Jaipur-inspired stage and mandap for the jaimala ceremony. The structure is planned to be around 100 feet wide, 35 feet long and 30 feet high. Flowers are being sourced from China and Bengaluru, while special lighting equipment has been brought in from Bengal.Five helipads are also being constructed for VIP guests.An SUV for the horse race winnerThe wedding celebrations will include a horse-racing competition scheduled for November 25, from 2pm to 4pm. The winner will receive an SUV, while the second and third-place finishers will get a motorcycle and a scooter.The event is expected to bring horses and riders from several states. A stable is also being constructed at Nadawan to accommodate the animals.A feast for around four lakh guestsFood is expected to be another major attraction, with more than 150 varieties planned for the wedding feast. The arrangements are expected to cater to around four lakh guests.The menu will include traditional Bihari dishes as well as food from other states. articles.title: After Hours: How tech leaders are redefining luxury evening dressing
articles.summary: When technology's biggest names step away from their boardrooms, their wardrobes can take a different direction.
articles.body: When technology's biggest names step away from their boardrooms, their wardrobes can take a different direction. Think black leather jackets, relaxed tailoring, rich textures and elevated basics. The new language of after-hours dressing sits somewhere between quiet luxury and statement fashion.What does Elon Musk wear when he isn't in the office? How does Sundar Pichai approach dressing for an evening event? And why does Satya Nadella's understated style feel so different from the traditional image of a corporate leader?The wardrobes of technology executives are interesting because they don't always follow the usual rules of power dressing. While traditional business fashion is associated with tailored suits, formal shirts and polished shoes, many technology leaders prefer clothing that feels more relaxed and personal.An evening with some of the most influential names from the technology and business world doesn't necessarily mean a room full of tuxedos and conventional cocktail outfits.At The ET Conversations session, Behind Closed Doors: Nikesh Arora in Conversation, at The St. Regis Mumbai on November 25, 2026, the evening's fashion story is just as interesting as the gathering itself.From black leather jackets and dark denim to relaxed knitwear, textured outerwear and understated accessories, the style choices reflect a different side of executive dressing. These are outfits that don't necessarily follow the traditional rules of formal evening wear. They are comfortable, polished and, in some cases, a little experimental.But don't mistake simple dressing for inexpensive dressing. Some of the most recognisable tech CEO outfits come with surprisingly high price tags. Mark Zuckerberg's familiar grey T-shirts have reportedly cost $300 to $400 apiece, while Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's signature leather jacket made headlines after selling for $960,000 at an auction.The black leather jacket makes an entranceWho says an evening event always calls for a blazer? A black leather jacket can make just as much of an impression, especially when paired with a simple black top and dark denim. Jensen Huang's $8,990 Tom Ford lizard-embossed jacket is an interesting example of how texture can transform a familiar wardrobe staple. Although it was made from embossed calf leather, its distinctive finish gave the otherwise familiar black jacket a more experimental appearance.This look gets the balance right. The jacket adds a little attitude, the jeans keep things comfortable and the pendant necklace brings in a personal touch. It doesn't look like someone has spent hours putting an outfit together, and that's precisely the appeal.For tech leaders who are more comfortable in understated clothing than elaborate formalwear, this is an interesting way to dress up without changing their entire style.The case for keeping it simpleNot everyone wants to make a statement with a bold jacket or flashy accessories. Sometimes, a well-fitted dark sweater and a pair of light-coloured trousers are enough. Mark Zuckerberg is an interesting example of how expensive simplicity can become. His familiar grey T-shirts have been reported to be custom-made by Italian luxury label Brunello Cucinelli, with individual pieces reportedly costing between $300 and $400. That's quite a price for something that looks like an ordinary grey T-shirt.The Meta chief's wardrobe has also evolved beyond his earlier uniform of grey tees and hoodies. His growing interest in luxury watches has added another dimension to his personal style. In January 2025, he was spotted wearing a Greubel Forsey Hand Made 1 watch, which retailed for $895,500 before taxes. Only two or three of these watches are produced each year, according to the watchmaker.This is the kind of outfit that feels familiar but still looks put together. The dark knitwear keeps things smart, while the lighter trousers make the combination feel less like everyday office clothing. There's no tie, no elaborate layering and no attempt to look overly formal.It is also a reminder that evening dressing doesn't have to mean buying an entirely new wardrobe. A few good basics, worn well, can do the job.Style note: A fine-knit sweater is a useful alternative to a formal shirt. Pair it with tailored trousers and clean sneakers for an evening gathering where comfort matters as much as appearance.The crocodile textured jacket: When luxury becomes a statementA black leather jacket is one way to make an entrance. A crocodile-textured jacket reportedly valued at a staggering $960,000 takes things to an entirely different level.Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has made the black leather jacket almost a personal uniform. His association with luxury label Tom Ford has also brought attention to the price of his wardrobe. A lizard-embossed Tom Ford leather jacket he wore at an Nvidia event in 2024 was identified by Tom's Hardware as a piece from the brand's Spring/Summer 2023 collection, priced at $8,990.But another jacket took the story to an entirely different level. A signed black Tom Ford leather jacket worn by Huang sold for $960,000 at Sotheby's in July 2026. It had an auction estimate of $40,000 to $60,000, making the final price a remarkable jump. The sale was part of a charity auction titled The CEO's Uniform.This is the more extravagant side of after-hours dressing, where the material itself becomes the talking point. Leather has a distinctive finish that immediately draws attention. Its pattern, surface and rich appearance make it very different from the familiar smooth leather jacket.At this price point, the jacket is no longer just another piece of outerwear. It becomes a statement of exclusivity and craftsmanship, and an example of how far luxury fashion can go.The interesting contrast is that the rest of the outfit doesn't necessarily need to compete with it. A simple dark shirt, well-cut trousers and minimal accessories can allow such a distinctive jacket to take centre stage.Style note: You don't need a six-figure jacket to experiment with this look. Crocodile-embossed leather, textured jackets and accessories with distinctive finishes can bring a similar visual element to an outfit at a much lower price.A little texture goes a long waySometimes, it isn't the colour or cut of an outfit that catches the eye. It's the fabric.Suede, embossed leather, crocodile-textured finishes and unusual materials can make even a simple jacket stand out. You don't necessarily need a loud print or a bright colour to make an impression. This is where the more experimental side of After Hours dressing comes in. A statement jacket can do all the talking while the rest of the outfit stays relatively simple.Style note: If you're trying a textured jacket for the first time, keep your shirt, trousers and shoes understated. One standout piece is often enough.The relaxed jacket that works beyond the boardroomA jacket doesn't always have to look corporate. An olive, brown or muted-toned jacket can add character without making an outfit feel too formal.Elon Musk has also been spotted in leather outerwear rather than conventional business suits. At the 2023 New York Times DealBook Summit, he wore a black flight-style leather jacket with a fur collar. Fashion coverage identified it as a Belstaff Mustang jacket, priced at approximately $1,695, although the identification was not officially confirmed by the brand.The trick is in how you wear it. Pair it with a simple dark top, comfortable trousers and minimal accessories. The result feels appropriate for a dinner, an informal networking evening or an exclusive industry gathering.It is a practical approach to dressing, particularly for people who move between professional commitments and social events without wanting to change their entire look.Style note: Look for relaxed cuts, interesting finishes and colours that work with the basics already in your wardrobe.The new evening uniform is all about personalityThe interesting thing about After Hours dressing is that there isn't one uniform to follow. One person might choose a black leather jacket, another might prefer a dark sweater, while someone else could make a statement with textured outerwear.Think of the understated approach often associated with technology leaders such as Satya Nadella and Sundar Pichai. Their public style is generally more about comfort, clean silhouettes and personal ease than elaborate formal dressing.The idea isn't to copy anyone's wardrobe. It is to find a way of looking polished that still feels like you.And that's perhaps the best part of this fashion direction. You don't have to wear a tuxedo to look ready for an important evening. Sometimes, a great jacket, a comfortable pair of trousers and the confidence to keep things simple are all you need.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: No 10 does not rule out inviting back influencer at centre of video row
articles.summary: It comes after Kemi Badenoch called on the PM to apologise for allowing an "obscene" video to be recorded outside Number 10.
articles.body:
Downing Street has not ruled out inviting the creator of a video which was branded "not acceptable" by Andy Burnham to future events at Number 10.

Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch called on the PM to apologise for "debasing his office" by allowing Max Balegde to record a video on the steps of Number 10, which included "vile" and "obscene" comments about women.

Burnham said the video had been taken down and Balegde had "rightly apologised" for it - but he said he would not apologise for engaging with influencers who could reach young people.

Asked repeatedly whether Balegde would be invited back, the prime minister's official spokesman said: "I'm not going to get ahead of future events."

The spokesman was responding to a comment the influencer filmed after he had left the event on 9 November and posted in a YouTube video before the public criticism.

In it, Max Balegde said of the event the PM hosted, "well guys that was a huge success, Andy's invited me round for tea".

The PM's spokesman was unable to confirm whether that invite was legitimate or whether a further meeting would go ahead.

Downing Street also could not say whether Balegde had ever been paid taxpayer money to collaborate with the government on social media posts.

No influencers were paid to attend the Downing Street reception, the PM's spokesman added, but influencers have in the past been paid when working with other government departments.

About 60 content creators were invited to the Downing Street reception on 9 November, with videos from the event, including of Burnham DJing, subsequently emerging online.

In one video, Max Balegde, whose real name is Max Trobe, mouths the words "bomboclaat pussywagon chicken nuggets", using audio from a meme that is trending online.

At Prime Minister's Questions, Badenoch said the words used were "so offensive that I will not repeat them in this House".

"Disgusting and pejorative comments about women's private parts, obscene language that referred to white women as cheap meat.

"This is grotesque. Labour MPs constantly tell us about their commitment to fighting violence against women and girls. Those MPs were silent yesterday, I won't be."

Burnham said the Tory leader was "right to call out that, because it was not acceptable" but he would "not apologise" for engaging with young people.

"She sneers at TikTokers, she sneers at influencers," he added, accusing Badenoch of "having nothing positive to say to the country" and of "constantly talking it down".

The two leaders continued the argument throughout their weekly Commons clash, with Burnham saying "it's true I have spoken to influencers, and then I have to come to this House, with the opposite of influencers".

Badenoch said the PM preferred to "take questions to people dancing around Downing Street", a reference to a video of another content creator dancing through Number 10 and down the stairs in an attempt to recreate a scene from the film Love, Actually.

This prompted Burnham to make a jibe about "lockdown parties" in Downing Street during the Covid pandemic.

Responding to the row about his now-deleted TikTok video in an Instagram post on Tuesday, Balegde said: "My content is always meant to be silly, fun, and light-hearted.

"If anybody was offended by that video, I sincerely apologise."

But he said "nobody was offended for weeks until revolting right-wing people tried to put this disgusting narrative on it".

"And if anybody then looks at the video and is offended, I get that. So hence why I took it down because I think that is disgusting."

Videos which were filmed inside the Downing Street premises were recorded on government phones.

Attendees at the event have confirmed they had to hand personal devices in and were given a phone and a camera to film with, with the footage they recorded sent to them after the event.

Artist Sophie Tea, who has more than 1.3 million followers on TikTok, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme she had been "excited" to be invited to the Downing Street reception, describing it as a "privilege".

"I believe in the democratization of information and I think this opportunity was perfect for me to be able to understand more what's going on.

"Number 10 is meant to represent the whole country and the more people feel like they belong there, the better."

She said she was looking to use her social media platform to "communicate to the UK some of the brilliant things that are happening in government".

Asked if she was being used by the government, she said "absolutely" but it was "mutually exploitative" because, as an independent artist, she had used it to "prop up my own value".

Tories accuse Burnham of turning No 10 into 'joke' after influencer video row

Artist among first to sell work on TikTok Shop

This isn't the first time influencers have been invited into Downing Street. Former Prime Minister Rishi Sunak was interviewed by content creators during his time in office.

Nor is it the first time they have descended onto Number 10 en masse, with the first content creator reception taking place under Sir Keir Starmer's leadership in 2025.

Content creators are also regularly invited to press conferences and government briefings, including an event at Number 11 Downing Street on the day of the Budget last month.

Writing on X, Luke Tryl, the UK director of pollsters More In Common, said it was "sensible" for Burnham to use influencers to reach a wider audience and it was "helping the PM seem in touch".

But, he added, the PM's "biggest weakness" was being seen as a "people pleaser" and he should also do "non-softball interviews with traditional scrutiny media" to help tackle that.

articles.title: Sudan’s RSF kills at least 19 in drone attacks on Blue Nile state
articles.summary: The attacks on Blue Nile state also wounded at least 20 people – in a drone war that is quickly escalating.
articles.body:
At least 19 people have been killed in drone attacks by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in Sudan’s Blue Nile state, according to a rights group.

A Sudanese military source told Al Jazeera that the RSF, which has been fighting Sudan’s army since 2023, targeted the city of Damazin in a series of attacks late on Tuesday that also wounded at least 20 people.

The attacks targeted multiple sites across Damazin, the capital of Blue Nile, and the neighbouring town of Roseires.

Three families were killed in the bombing of a residential area in Damazin, the military source said.

According to Emergency Lawyers, a rights group based in the Sudanese capital, Khartoum, drone attacks also targeted electricity facilities in Damazin and a big dam in Roseires.

Emergency Lawyers said six women were among the dead.

Sudan is currently in the grip of a large-scale civil war between the Khartoum-based Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the RSF.

The southeastern Blue Nile state is strategically significant because it neighbours some of Sudan’s most unstable regions and is home to some of the SAF’s most experienced fighters, Al Jazeera’s Almigdad Alruhaid explained.

Reporting from Khartoum’s twin-city of Omdurman, Alruhaid said, “The attacks come amid a sharp escalation in the use of drone attacks between the RSF and the SAF in the last days.”

On November 22, drone attacks in Sudan’s capital area around Khartoum and Omdurman killed at least four people and damaged a United Nations building while staff were inside.

Between January and June this year, at least 1,390 civilians were killed in Sudan – 80 percent of them by drones. In the following four months, another 840 civilians were killed, including about 520 in drone attacks.

“Civilians right now are paying the price. There is no safe zone for civilians, whether in Damazin or in Khartoum,” Alruhaid said.

Civil war broke out in Sudan in mid-April 2023 after a power-sharing agreement between two rival camps fell apart following the protest-led ousting of then-President Omar al-Bashir in 2019.

Two rival military leaders emerged in al-Bashir’s wake: Sudan’s de facto ruler Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, who now heads the SAF, and his deputy-turned-rival Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, also known as “Hemedti”, who heads the RSF.

Each accuses the other of attacking first and starting the war that is now in its fourth year.

Reports say the war in Sudan has killed at least 59,000 people, displaced about 13 million and pushed parts of the country into famine.

articles.title: Virginia school district defends Thanksgiving 'Day of Mourning' resources for kids as young as third grade
articles.summary: Loudoun County Public Schools defends Thanksgiving resources describing the holiday as a "Day of Mourning" for some Native Americans, per watchdog report.
articles.body: A Virginia school district at the center of past education controversies is defending Thanksgiving "resources" for children as young as third grade that describes the holiday as a "Day of Mourning" for some Native Americans, according to documents obtained by the watchdog group Protect the Public's Trust. "The Loudoun County Public Schools (LCPS) Resources for Recognition Days & Months guide does not label Thanksgiving a ‘Day of Mourning,’" LCPS Communications told Fox News Digital in a statement Wednesday. "Rather, it includes multiple suggested resources that explore Thanksgiving traditions and historical perspectives, including Native American perspectives." Loudoun County Public Schools, located outside Washington, D.C., includes the "resources" in a district resource guide for teachers, according to a Washington Free Beacon report. The materials also reportedly featured a Columbus Day lesson described as a "Debated Celebration," while Christmas does not appear in the guide's listed holiday resources. LOUDOUN SCHOOL BOARD URGES STUDENTS TO ‘CELEBRATE’ LGBTQ+ HISTORY IN NEW PROCLAMATION A slide for grades 3–5 labeled "The Real Story of Thanksgiving," shared by The Washington Free Beacon, reads, "Some Native American groups protest Thanksgiving as a Day of Mourning. They claim that the arrival of European explorers and settlers is not a cause for celebration, because it began the ill-treatment and deaths of millions of Native Americans. For them, Thanksgiving marks the beginning of a long period of violence and discrimination." LCPS Communications went on to say that the guide contains optional teaching materials rather than mandatory curriculum, noting that educators are not required to use any specific lessons or activities. The district said the resources include materials from the Virginia Department of Education as well as supplementary content, and that teachers are encouraged to determine which materials are appropriate for their individual classrooms. VIRGINIA SCHOOL DISTRICT FACES PROBE OVER 9/11 TEACHING GUIDE TELLING TEACHERS NOT TO ‘CENTER THE EXTREMISTS’ "Thanksgiving is included in the LCPS curriculum and is taught in accordance with Virginia’s History and Social Science Standards of Learning," LCPS Communications continued. "In second grade, students learn about Thanksgiving traditions and the origins of the holiday. Instruction also includes opportunities to learn about Native American history and perspectives, including the Wampanoag tribe." LCPS added that it is "intentional about ensuring students have opportunities to learn history through multiple perspectives and develop a more complete understanding of historical events. Instruction is designed to be age-appropriate and aligned with students’ developmental levels." HOW VIRGINIA SCHOOL DISTRICT SHAMES KIDS TO MARK THANKSGIVING The Washington Free Beacon also reported that a district-approved Thanksgiving lesson for middle and high school students, titled "Thanksgiving: A Day of Mixed Blessings," features a HuffPost-produced video examining why some Native Americans observe a National Day of Mourning on Thanksgiving. The video opens with a man invoking Malcolm X's famous remarks about Plymouth Rock to describe the arrival of European settlers from a Native American perspective. Loudoun County Public Schools said its resource guide includes materials addressing both Columbus Day and Indigenous Peoples’ Day, consistent with Virginia’s educational standards. The district added that the guide does not include dedicated resources for religious holidays such as Christmas, Hanukkah, Eid and Diwali, but said those holidays are covered in the elementary curriculum under state standards. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "LCPS remains committed to providing a high-quality education that meets the needs of all students and prepares them for future success," LCPS Communications added. In a statement to Fox News Digital, Alexa Moutevelis, Protect the Public's Trust communications director, said, "From introducing elementary school students to LGBTQ pride to teaching children that Thanksgiving is a ‘Day of Mourning,’ Loudoun County seems determined to filter American history and traditions through a DEI lens. There’s nothing wrong with teaching the complicated parts of American history, but these materials seem to emphasize grievance, oppression, and critical interpretations." Moutevelis added, "It’s a good reminder for parents to pay attention to messages their children are receiving in the classroom and how public schools are choosing to frame important holidays and historical events."

articles.title: 400-year-old shipwreck lock finally opened after researchers crack secret code: 'Incredibly satisfying'
articles.summary: Revealing the code ANCE, a 400-year-old combination lock from the Ann Francis shipwreck was cracked by scientists using micro-CT scanning at Cardiff University.
articles.body: A 400-year-old brass lock recovered from a 16th-century shipwreck off the coast of Wales has finally been opened — and researchers didn't need a key to crack it. The discovery, conducted as a joint effort between Amgueddfa Cymru (Museum Wales) and Cardiff University, was announced earlier this month. Museum officials said in a statement that the brass lock had "remained firmly locked" since its vessel was destroyed off the coast of Wales in the 16th century. DIVERS UNCOVER HUNDREDS OF ANCIENT RELICS NEAR SHIPWRECK UNTOUCHED FOR 2,100 YEARS The Ann Francis was overtaken by a storm on Dec. 28, 1583, while returning from Spain. It was blown off course before wrecking on Margam Beach, near Port Talbot. More than 400 years later, metal detectorist Peter Hughes began unearthing parts of the ship's hoard on Margam Beach in 1996. He continued recovering artifacts from the site through 2017 — including the brass lock — after dredging and storms stripped away layers of sand. Speaking to officials, Hughes said he was "immediately astonished" when he uncovered the lock. TREASURE HUNTER STRIKES GOLD WITH 1,000-YEAR-OLD DISCOVERY LINKED TO 'HAND OF GOD' "When I moved the ring dials of the combination, they turned with ease after over 400 years beneath the sands, and I was left in disbelief," he said, as Cardiff University reported. "I also remember being left excited at the prospect of finding wonderful things [in] the treasure chest it once locked." Researchers revealed the four-letter combination that kept it sealed for more than four centuries: ANCE. To crack the code without damaging the artifact, museum experts partnered with specialists at Cardiff University to examine the lock's internal mechanism using CT scanning technology. "Now [that] we've solved it, we are left wondering if the code meant something to its owner." 'SPECTACULAR' SHIPWRECK FOUND WITH UNDERWATER TIME CAPSULE OF UNTOUCHED CARGO: 'AMAZING FIND' David Williams, a research associate at Cardiff University's School of Engineering, said micro-CT scanning allowed him to inspect the interior of the lock without harming it. "By creating a detailed 3D image of the internal mechanism, I could see how the notches lined up with the letters and identify the exact combination," said Williams, according to Cardiff University. "We normally use this technology to study bones and other biological structures, so investigating a 400-year-old padlock was certainly a first for us," he said. After waiting until later that evening for museum officials to test the code, Williams got the news that it worked. "Getting the message that we'd cracked it was incredibly satisfying," he said. CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR OUR LIFESTYLE NEWSLETTER Alastair Willis, a senior curator at Amgueddfa Cymru, said the meaning behind the lock's code remains unknown. "Elizabethan combination locks are known in Britain, but this one is in exceptionally good condition and is associated with a dated wreck, making it a unique find and the code a tantalizing mystery to solve," said Willis, the release noted. He added, "Of course, now [that] we've solved it, we are left wondering if the code meant something to its owner." Officials said the lock is believed to have once secured a small chest holding valuables. CLICK HERE FOR MORE LIFESTYLE NEWS Because it was found near Spanish silver coins and two coin weights, researchers think it may have protected those items or a chest containing organic materials that did not survive, such as documents or textiles. The hoard also included rare gold coins dating to the reign of Ferdinand and Isabella of Spain, as well as a boatswain's whistle. The combination lock and other artifacts from the Ann Francis hoard are now on display at the National Waterfront Museum in Swansea. TEST YOURSELF WITH OUR LATEST LIFESTYLE QUIZ Recent archaeological and historical finds across Wales have drawn similar attention. Earlier this year, archaeologists revealed new findings from a remote Roman fort in Wales — including fourth-century coins and artifacts — that may link the site to a centuries-old legend about Emperor Magnus Maximus. articles.title: Comedian Alfred Robles wears many hats: Cowboy, Catholic and crowd therapist
articles.summary: Alfred Robles reveals why fans say he wears his signature tejana wrong, and how Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias pushed him from blurry photos to headliner.
articles.body: After Alfred Robles’ career took off, he started noticing something funny on the comedy circuit: other comics adopted cowboy hats of their own, hoping for a piece of the magic that turned him into a headliner. "Everybody thought that I started blowing up because of the hat. After that, I saw a bunch of comedians wearing hats waiting to blow up," Robles told Fox News Digital in a sit-down interview following the release of his new YouTube stand-up special, "El Cowboy." The irony is that Robles’ signature tejana didn't start as a branding play at all, and according to the older guys in his community, he’s not even wearing it right. "The crazy part is there's a wrong way to wear a hat, and I wear it the wrong way," the East L.A.-raised comic said, explaining that the hat is "supposed" to be worn low so it covers your eyes. "I get a lot of older Mexicans [who] come up to me [saying], 'I love it, but you wear it wrong.' I go, 'I know, I get it, bro. But the reason why I do it is because I'm being filmed, and I want them to see my eyes and my face and all that.'" "'You're still wearing it wrong!'" the cowboy hat purists say. For Robles, the hat isn’t a calculated gimmick. It’s just a piece of his background adjusted to fit the stage, much like the rest of his unconventional path to headlining. COMEDIAN DES BISHOP ON HOW AMERICA MADE HIM FUNNIER AND HIS 'HEALTHY COLLABORATION' WITH WIFE HANNAH BERNER Before he was headlining theaters and dropping back-to-back comedy specials, the East L.A. native tried on plenty of other roles: police academy cadet, retail security guard, shaky-handed tour photographer and reluctant caretaker — all before becoming a tequila-pouring comedy therapist for hundreds of strangers a night, with a little help from renowned stand-up comedian Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias along the way. From cadet to comedian Comedy wasn't part of the neighborhood curriculum growing up in East L.A. (and don't confuse it with neighboring Boyle Heights, a distinction Robles still guards with hometown pride). Nobody around Robles was talking about open mics, aside from his childhood friend Jay Hernandez, who the comedian said treated acting like an inevitable business plan long before landing his starring role in the "Magnum P.I." reboot and other Hollywood credits. For Robles, stand-up only came into focus after his first career choice fell apart. He first enrolled in the police academy before being disqualified due to a restraining order filed by an ex-girlfriend in his early 20s. "It was a long time ago. I was innocent, guys." "And then, right after I got kicked out from the police academy, I went straight into comedy," he said, recalling that he used to write jokes and poems in high school. DAVID CROSS DOESN’T 'GIVE A F---’: THE ACTOR-COMEDIAN ON HIS NEW SPECIAL, SOCIAL MEDIA AND ‘TERRIFYING’ AI "I said to myself, maybe that was my calling — is to become a comedian." At the time, Robles was living with his mother and working a loss prevention job at Old Navy. "In the early 2000s I was making $17 an hour. So that was a lot of money," he said. "So I went from $17 an hour, 40 hours a week, to getting paid drink tickets." He said his mother was skeptical at first, but that he was glad she was still around to see his success, even if she doesn't understand enough English to really get his jokes. "The only positive thing she said was, 'You know what? I didn't understand you, but the people were laughing, and I was proud,'" he said. That was good enough for him. Robles' big, 'Fluffy' break His big break arrived a few years into his open-mic grind in the early 2000s at a bar show in Montebello, California, when Iglesias pulled him aside with a blunt piece of advice: cut the profanity. "He goes, 'You cuss a lot. I know you don't need your cussing because you don't say it in your punchlines. You'll just clean that up, and you'll go far,'" Robles recalled. He was resistant at first, but cleaned up his set anyway. Iglesias saw the difference and invited Robles on the road in 2010, though not as an opener. "He told me, 'You know what, I'm going to give you a spot, but you're not going to go up on stage, you're going to take pictures for me,'" Robles said. JEFF ARCURI REVEALS HOW 'BACHELORETTE' WIFE’S CANCER FIGHT TRANSFORMED HIS COMEDY — AND THEIR MARRIAGE "I'm not even a photographer, bro. I don't even know a camera... The messed-up part is my hands shake, so every picture was messed up." "Anything to get your foot in," Robles maintained. "That's the way I saw it." Those blurry photos eventually turned into five-minute sets, then 10-minute spots, and eventually led to Robles performing at arenas like Madison Square Garden and Dodger Stadium alongside Iglesias. Still, Robles knew he couldn't build a legacy as someone else's opener. "I didn't do comedy to become someone's friend. I said, 'You know, I got to start my own life. I got to start my career.' I don't want to go thinking, 'Oh, I never tried it, to go on my own.'" He hired a videographer friend of his, with whom he has now been working for nearly four years. "We grew together. And now I'm here headlining across the country. And it was because I took a risk on myself, and I bet on myself. And I started posting clips up, and the clips blew up." The momentum snowballed into a massive recent run, capped by releasing two specials within two months of each other. The first was a Kevin Hart-produced half-hour on Hulu in September, and the second was his new hour, "El Cowboy," which dropped in November. 'Now we're all crying, bro.' Robles' comedy routine begins with around 45–50 minutes of traditional stand-up before he starts to "mess around" and bring people up on stage. It all started because he likes crowd work, and he used to enjoy playing matchmaker by bringing single people in his audience on stage. Then, one onlooker raised his hand and, instead of looking for a hook-up, wanted an outlet to share a problem. "So he came up onstage, and he just told me a sad story. And I go, 'Bro, do you want a shot?'" He did. COMEDIAN MATT RIFE SAYS HE DITCHED HOLLYWOOD'S OLD PLAYBOOK FOR SUCCESS AFTER HITTING 'ROCK BOTTOM' "So I give him a shot and just, that took me to another level ... So now, at the end of the show, I just ask them, 'Hey, whoever's going through a problem or just has a story they want to share with me, we'll take a shot together.'" Robles speculated that speaking openly about his own experiences set the stage for everybody else to open up. "And then the alcohol helps. Now we're all crying, bro," he laughed. The unfiltered nature of the audience-interaction portion of Robles' show occasionally leads to unexpected places, Robles told Fox News Digital. One woman's story about sleeping with an ex during a two-day breakup with her baby's father and what followed prompted Robles to blur her face in his clips, even though she never asked him to. But it has also led him to shoot eight episodes of a series "kind of like 'The Jerry Springer Show'" focused on the audience participation piece of his act that he now wants to pitch. "My stuff is just all real, bro. They're real problems, real people, man. So people love that. People love problems, as long as it's not your problem." Standing up to stigma The candor of the crowd is cultivated by Robles' own honest discussion of topics that could be considered taboo in Mexican-American culture, like men's health and aging. "El Cowboy" features a bit about Robles' first time having enough money to afford a visit to the doctor's office and the unexpected prostate exam that followed. "The reason why I say it a lot, too — and I love that joke — is because, in my culture, Mexican men don't want to go have your prostate checked," Robles said, adding that nowadays you can get a blood test instead of a digital rectal exam. "They still don't even want to do that because a lot of them don't want to know. For whatever reason, that's big in our culture. They do not want to know, and I'm over here trying to tell them, 'Hey bro, you got to know, man! You could save your life,'" he said. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE "We just feel like, if we know, and we tell someone else, now we put, like, a burden on them. Now they're going to feel sorry for us, and I don't want that to happen. And that's something I want to break." One friend of his lost a toe to diabetes, to which Robles said, "If you would have went to the doctor, bro, a year before, you would've had a toe." Another friend had a stroke while working at Disneyland, and instead of seeking help for his symptoms, he left the park to have the stroke in his car because he didn't want to bother anyone. "Well, you could have died, fool," Robles said. "You would have died in the happiest place in the world." 'I'm already living my dream.' Beneath the on-stage bravado, the cowboy hat and the late-night tequila shots sits one more role that anchors everything else: a grounded Catholic kid from East L.A. who still relies on quiet faith. Robles admitted he hasn't been to church in a while, but prayer remains a constant rhythm in his day. "I pray when I wake up, and I pray at night ... I mean I forget here and there, but I always catch myself praying. You know, when I jump on a flight, when I jump on the freeway ... When I'm sitting down just having my own thoughts, that's when I pray," he said. "I never lost faith, bro. I just grinded and grinded and prayed and prayed, and here I am." Even with a new special in the works and an unscripted TV project ready to pitch, Robles doesn't measure his career by what’s still on the horizon. After years of wearing many hats, he’s content with where things stand. CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "My dream? I'm already living my dream, man. Whatever happens, happens, bro. I'm cool if it does, and I'm cool if it doesn't," he said. "Like I said earlier, bro, I didn't do this to be someone's friend. I didn't do this to blow up. I did it because I love comedy. The rest is just extra, bro, and I am cool with that."

articles.title: Catalan separatist Puigdemont to return to Spain on December 12
articles.summary: Former regional leader says he will unveil his proposal for a renewed Catalan independence push on December 17.
articles.body:
Catalan separatist and former regional leader Carles Puigdemont has said he will return to Spain on December 12, ending nearly a decade of self-imposed exile.

Speaking at a televised news conference from Brussels on Wednesday, Puigdemont said he would unveil his proposal for a renewed Catalan independence push on December 17.

Puigdemont’s return to Spain comes after the Supreme Court applied an amnesty law and shelved the criminal case against him .

“I left as president of the government of Catalonia, and I will return to the place where Catalan democracy elects or dismisses its presidents: the Parliament of Catalonia,” the former leader said.

He added: “I will do so on Saturday, 12 December, at midday, and that very night I will be able to sleep at home, with my family,” Puigdemont told the Brussels news conference.

Puigdemont fled to Belgium in October 2017 after organising an independence referendum that Spanish courts deemed illegal.

The vote triggered Spain’s worst political crisis in decades and deepened tensions between Madrid and Catalonia, a wealthy northeastern region with its own language, culture and a strong separatist movement.

Puigdemont briefly returned to Spain in August 2024, delivering a defiant speech in Catalan capital Barcelona, advocating for Catalonia’s right to self-determination before disappearing and prompting a police operation.

The amnesty, approved by parliament in 2024, was part of a deal between Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s Socialist Party and Catalan separatist groups, including Puigdemont’s Junts party, after an inconclusive election in 2023.

Spain’s conservative opposition unsuccessfully challenged the measure in the courts and parliament.

Puigdemont will return to Spain after this Sunday’s snap general election . Opinion polls suggest a potential coalition of the conservative People’s Party ‌and far-right Vox – both strong supporters of a unified Spain – winning an absolute majority of parliamentary seats.
